messages.text: At that rate the KBeast would be about $58 a month in power. One catch: the KBeast is off sale right now, so what I'd point you at is the Magic Miner 40T, $799. First miner, or adding to a setup?

Same story as the KBeast, unfortunately — the PunkHash has no units released for sale right now, and it's Q4 2026 from the supplier with no firmer date. It's also a big one: ~1.45 kW, so about $104 a month at 10¢, and it wants its own circuit.

What you can actually buy today is the Magic Miner 40T at $799 — cheapest per terahash we stock, ships Nov 21, 2026. Want me to run the sats and block odds on it at your rate?

context.pop: At 10¢ the GekkoScience KBeast runs about $58 a month, at 16¢ about $92 — what do you pay for power?
